purpose: Verify loading reads the manifest roots, resolves every child by walking parent id lists, and reports missing, unparseable or broken documents as structured errors without crashing.
title: Tree load and walk

testCases.description: walkTree reads the manifest roots and loads every document on the live tree with zero errors
testCases.testPointer: test/store/walker.test.js::walkTree on the live tree loads every document and returns zero errors

testCases.description: an unparseable document surfaces as a structured parseFailure naming the document id while the walk continues
testCases.testPointer: test/store/walker.test.js::walkTree reports parseFailure without crashing the walk

testCases.description: a broken prdId reference surfaces as a brokenReference error naming document, field and file
